tagline: Sync customer bug reports from HubSpot to Jira tickets automatically
metaTitle: Jira + HubSpot Integration: Customer Bugs to Jira Tickets
metaDescription: Get customer bugs to engineering fast. GAIA files a Jira ticket from each HubSpot bug report and tells the owner when it ships. See the setup steps.
intro:
Customer-reported bugs logged in HubSpot need to reach engineering in Jira, but the handoff is almost always manual. A support rep logs a bug, then someone reads it, decides it belongs with engineering, creates the ticket, and periodically checks back to update the CRM when engineering resolves it. That chain is slow, inconsistent, and dependent on people remembering to close the loop.

GAIA automates the path from bug report to ticket and back. When a customer bug is logged in HubSpot and meets your configured criteria, GAIA creates a Jira ticket with the full customer context attached. As the ticket progresses, GAIA updates the original support ticket. When engineering resolves the bug, GAIA notifies the account owner in the CRM so they can communicate the fix to the customer.

This integration is most impactful for B2B SaaS teams where customer-reported bugs have direct revenue implications and where closing the loop with the customer requires coordination between customer success, engineering, and sales.

useCases.title: Create Jira tickets from HubSpot customer bug reports
useCases.description: When a HubSpot support ticket is classified as a bug and linked to an account above your ARR threshold, GAIA creates a bug ticket with the customer description, affected account, deal value, and a link to the original ticket so engineering has full context to reproduce and prioritize the issue.

useCases.title: Notify account owners when Jira bugs are resolved
useCases.description: When a Jira bug ticket linked to an account is resolved, GAIA creates an activity on the deal and sends a task to the account owner so they know to reach out to the customer with the good news.

useCases.title: Aggregate customer impact on existing bugs
useCases.description: When multiple support tickets report the same underlying bug, GAIA links them to a single bug ticket and increments an affected-accounts counter on the issue. Engineering can sort the backlog by customer impact to prioritize fixes that affect the most accounts.

useCases.title: Post status updates back to HubSpot tickets
useCases.description: As a bug moves through the workflow, to In Progress, In Review, and Resolved, GAIA posts corresponding status updates to the linked support ticket so the support team can answer customer inquiries about fix timing without opening the bug ticket.

useCases.title: Escalate VIP bug reports to urgent priority
useCases.description: When a bug report comes from a contact at an account designated as a VIP tier, GAIA creates the ticket with Blocker priority and sends an immediate notification to the engineering lead so high-value customer issues are never deprioritized by accident.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your HubSpot portal and Jira project. Configure which ticket properties and deal characteristics should trigger ticket creation.

howItWorks.step: Define customer context mapping and escalation rules
howItWorks.description: Map deal properties to issue fields, set the account tier or ARR threshold that determines priority, and configure which issue state transitions should update the CRM.

howItWorks.step: Bugs flow from customers to engineering and back automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors for qualifying bug reports, creates tickets with customer context, and keeps the support ticket updated as engineering progresses. The customer loop closes without anyone managing it manually.

faqs.question: How does GAIA prevent duplicate Jira tickets when multiple customers report the same bug?
faqs.answer: GAIA uses semantic similarity matching to identify existing tickets that likely correspond to a new report. If a match above your configured confidence threshold exists, GAIA links the support ticket to the existing issue and increments the customer impact counter rather than creating a duplicate.

faqs.question: Does GAIA include customer PII from HubSpot in tickets?
faqs.answer: By default GAIA includes only the company name, account tier, and deal ARR in tickets — not individual contact names or email addresses. You can configure how much customer context to include based on your data handling policies.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle the reverse flow — engineering bugs that should proactively notify affected accounts?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to search the CRM for accounts likely affected by a newly filed bug based on product usage data or account properties. GAIA then creates tasks for the relevant account owners to proactively notify their customers.
